lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.

dishes.name: Summer berry oat square
dishes.title: Warm berry baked oats
dishes.method: Take one portion from the Wednesday cooking session and eat it warm.
dishes.why: It gives the student a straightforward breakfast while the first cooking session is already under way.

dishes.name: Smoky lentil bulgur bowl
dishes.title: Lentils, bulgur and cucumber
dishes.method: Spoon one portion each of the warm lentils and bulgur into a bowl. Add the chopped cucumber and yoghurt.
dishes.why: This turns two Wednesday preparations into a quick, fresh-edged lunch.

dishes.name: Lemon chicken summer bowl
dishes.title: Chicken, roasted vegetables and bulgur
dishes.method: Plate one warm portion each of chicken, roasted vegetables and bulgur directly from the cooking session. Squeeze over the lemon.
dishes.why: Freshly roasted chicken and vegetables provide a warm anchor without making a heavy August dinner.

dishes.name: Warm berry oat square
dishes.title: Reheated berry baked oats
dishes.method: Reheat one portion of baked oats until hot throughout.
dishes.why: The second portion makes Thursday breakfast immediate without repeating a cooking job.

dishes.name: Lemony chicken garden wrap
dishes.title: Chicken, roasted vegetables and leaves in a wrap
dishes.method: Spread the tortilla with yoghurt, then add the leaves and one cold portion each of sliced chicken and roasted vegetables. Roll firmly.
dishes.why: Yesterday's roast becomes a portable lunch rather than another bowl of the same meal.

dishes.name: Smoky lentil vegetable supper
dishes.title: Warm lentils and roasted vegetables
dishes.method: Reheat one portion each of the lentils and roasted vegetables together until piping hot.
dishes.why: The hot lentils provide a warm anchor while using the final vegetable portion within a day of cooking.

dishes.name: Golden spinach frittata
dishes.title: Warm spinach and Cheddar frittata
dishes.method: Eat one warm wedge directly from the Friday cooking session.
dishes.why: The second short cooking session starts with a warm egg breakfast and also prepares lunch.

dishes.name: Frittata tomato sandwich
dishes.title: Spinach frittata, tomato and wholemeal bread
dishes.method: Place the remaining frittata wedge and sliced tomato between the bread, then cut in half.
dishes.why: The frittata changes jobs at lunch, keeping the two Friday meals distinct.

dishes.name: Herby bean tomato skillet
dishes.title: Warm cannellini beans, tomatoes and courgette
dishes.method: Spoon one hot portion of the bean skillet into a bowl and serve with the bread. Freeze the second skillet portion once cool on Friday.
dishes.why: The beans are Friday evening's warm anchor, while the frozen spare prevents an inflated single plate.

preparations.title: Berry baked oats
preparations.method: Oil a small baking dish. Whisk the eggs, milk and cinnamon, stir in the oats and berries, and bake at 200°C until set and golden. Divide into two portions and refrigerate Thursday's portion once cool.

preparations.title: Lemon and thyme chicken
preparations.method: Coat the chicken with the oil, thyme, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Roast at 200°C until browned and cooked through, then divide into two portions. Refrigerate Thursday's portion promptly.

preparations.title: Roasted summer vegetables
preparations.method: Cut the vegetables into bite-sized pieces, toss with the oil, thyme, salt and pepper, and spread on a tray. Roast at 200°C until tender and browned at the edges. Divide into three portions and refrigerate two once cool.

preparations.title: Tender bulgur wheat
preparations.method: Put the bulgur, water and salt in a covered saucepan. Simmer gently until tender and the water is absorbed, then fluff and divide into two portions.

preparations.title: Smoky tomato lentils
preparations.method: Finely chop the onion and carrot. Soften them in the oil, stir in the paprika, then add the tomatoes and lentils. Simmer until thickened, season, and divide into two portions. Refrigerate Thursday's portion once cool.

preparations.title: Spinach and Cheddar frittata
preparations.method: Oil a small ovenproof dish. Wilt the spinach briefly, then add it to the dish. Beat the eggs with pepper, pour them over and scatter with grated Cheddar. Bake at 200°C until set, then cut into two wedges.

preparations.title: Herby bean and tomato skillet
preparations.method: Chop the onion and courgette. Soften them in the oil, add the thyme and tomatoes, and simmer briefly. Stir in the beans and cook until hot and thick. Serve one portion and cool and freeze the second portion on Friday.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Heat the oven to 200°C. Mix the baked oats and put them in first. Chop and season the roasting vegetables, then prepare the chicken and place both trays in the oven. Start the smoky lentils on the hob. Put the bulgur on while the lentils simmer. Remove each preparation as it finishes, eat the Wednesday portions, then cool and box the Thursday portions promptly.

Heat the oven to 200°C. Wilt the spinach, assemble the frittata and put it in the oven. While it bakes, chop the onion and courgette and cook the bean and tomato skillet on the hob. Cut the frittata into two wedges. Keep one skillet portion for dinner and cool and freeze the second portion on Friday.
